scenarios.title: An object with a color indicator is each color the indicator denotes

setup.notes: Dryad Arbor has no mana cost and a green color indicator.

decisions: No spells or abilities are used; both players pass priority with an empty stack.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Dryad Arbor is green, although it has no mana cost.

variants.label: back_face
variants.delta: A's permanent is Delver of Secrets already transformed into Insectile Aberration (no mana cost, blue color indicator) instead of Dryad Arbor.

variants.label: no_indicator
variants.delta: A's permanent is Forest (no mana cost, no color indicator) instead of Dryad Arbor.

variants.label: mana_cost_not_indicator
variants.delta: A's permanent is Ornithopter (mana cost {0}, no color indicator) instead of Dryad Arbor.

scenarios.forge_notes: Insectile Aberration is the back face of the card Forge names Delver of Secrets; the puzzle state must put it on the battlefield transformed.
